text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. One common type is supervised learning, where the computer uses training data that includes both inputs and correct answers. By studying this data, the computer builds a model, which is like a set of rules or patterns. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions on new, unseen data. For example, after learning from many pictures of cats and dogs, the model can predict what a new picture shows. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which tells us how often the model is correct. Higher accuracy means the model has learned well.
